EN: Maybe not all. Look at that!
ZH: 也许不全是，快看那边！

EN: They cleaned the place out on their way. All they left behind is garbage.
ZH: 他们在撤离时把这里打扫得干干净净，留下的全是没用的东西。

EN: I've got a bad feeling about this...
ZH: 我有种不祥的预感……

EN: INTRUDER. PLEASE PROVIDE IDENTIFICATION.
ZH: 入侵者！请提供身份证明。

EN: Vault-Tec Personnel identified.
ZH: 确认避难所科技人员身份。

EN: Error. Vault-Tec employees not authorized to access site data.
ZH: 错误。避难所科技员工无权访问现场数据。

EN: We're from Vault 76. Uh, here's my Pip Boy.
ZH: 我们是76号避难所的。呃，这是我的哔哔小子。

EN: Woah look at this thing. Alien tech!
ZH: 哇，看看这个东西。外星科技！

EN: Careful with that, you might punch a hole in the moon.
ZH: 小心点，别把月亮打穿了。

EN: Let's get this stuff back to the vault and comb the data.
ZH: 把这些东西带回避难所，仔细研究数据。

EN: Might be more of this stuff out there, ripe for the picking.
ZH: 可能还有更多东西在等着我们去捡！

EN: According to the crash site logs, Uncle Sam let RobCo have "the object" they were always gabbing about.
ZH: 根据坠毁现场的日志，政府把“那个东西”交给了罗伯科公司。

EN: This is the closest RobCo factory. It's gotta be here.
ZH: 这是离我们最近的罗伯科公司工厂，它肯定在这儿。

EN: Maybe, maybe not. I doubt they'd hide something like that somewhere so public.
ZH: 也许在，也许不在，我不认为他们会把这种东西藏在这么显眼的地方。

EN: This is the manager's office. Does the terminal still work?
ZH: 这是经理办公室，终端还好用吗？

EN: Got a holotape here with a whole bunch of entries.
ZH: 这里有一盘磁带，里头记录不少。

EN: That's gotta be it. Let's get back to the vault and dig a bit a deeper.
ZH: 那肯定是它了，回避难所深入挖掘一下数据。

EN: Yeah! There's something about a "government contract" at the "R&D lab." I think there are coordinates!
ZH: 太棒了！这里面提到什么“政府合同”和“研发实验室”，应该有相应的坐标！

EN: Let's get this back to the vault and plan our next move!
ZH: 快把这个带回避难所，计划我们的下一步！

EN: Where better to hide your secret research than under everyone's noses?
ZH: 灯下黑啊，哪里能比人们眼皮底下更安全呢？

EN: The secret research base is here? This is just a store. In a mall.
ZH: 秘密研究基地就在这？这只是商场里的一家商店而已吧。

EN: Woah! Don't shoot! I'm not like those other ones out there.
ZH: 哇！别开枪！我可不是外面那些家伙。

EN: It's good to meet something other than a feral Ghoul.
ZH: 真高兴能见到除了狂尸鬼之外的家伙。

EN: I'm Ed. I was an engineer here. Before my face went all 'radio.'
ZH: 我是埃德，在遭到辐射变异之前，曾经是这儿的工程师。

EN: The good stuff is down below. Take all you want, as long as you take me with you!
ZH: 好东西都在下面，你们尽管拿，前提是带我一起走！

EN: Cmoon! I can help your vault. And it's so BORING here... Go get what you came for! I'll help haul it back!
ZH: 拜托！我可以给你们的避难所提供帮助。这儿实在太无聊了……快去拿你们要的东西！我帮你们搬回去！

EN: Oh Thanks! I'll meet you outside when you're done. I can't wait to talk to people who can talk back!
ZH: 哦，谢谢！我在外面等你们干完。我等不及要和能说话的人聊聊了！

EN: Suit yourself. See you around I guess.
ZH: 随你吧，有缘再见。

EN: *gasp* It talks!
ZH: *吸气* 它会说话！

EN: Who are you? What are you doing here?
ZH: 你是谁？你在这儿干什么？

EN: We're from the vault nearby.We're looking for tech.
ZH: 我们来自附近的避难所，正在寻找科技。

EN: I dunno about this...
ZH: 我不知道……

EN: Hmm, you seem alright. Sure thing!
ZH: 嗯，你们看起来应该是好人。好吧，没问题！

EN: Ugh, no way. We'll be fine on our own.
ZH: 呃，还是不了。我们自己能搞定。

EN: Finally! Grab what you can and let's get back to the vault!
ZH: 终于！快拿上东西，然后回避难所！

EN: That's an oofo?
ZH: 这就是优艾富欧？

EN: There it is! We found it! Woah it's big.
ZH: 找到了！我们找到了！哇，好大！

EN: U. F. O. It's a... nevermind.
ZH: 那叫UFO……算了。

EN: Great. MORE killer robots.
ZH: 太好了，更多的杀手机器人。

EN: Intruder! Intruder!
ZH: 入侵者！入侵者！

EN: None shall pass. None shall pass. None shall pass.
ZH: 禁止通行。禁止通行。禁止通行。

EN: The anniversary of our first entering the Vault is approaching and it is a good opportunity to improve Vault morale by throwing a celebration! We've got food, we've got music, but it seems when VaulTec stocked our initial supplies, they forgot to include party decorations! We are going to have to send a team to the nearby Super Duper Mart to find some...
ZH: 进入避难所的周年纪念即将到来，让我们举办庆祝活动，提振避难所士气吧！虽然食物和音乐都不缺，但似乎避难所科技在储备物资时，忽视了派对装饰！我们得派人去附近的大无敌超市找一些回来……

EN: We didn't find any party supplies at the Super Duper Mart, but our team discovered that a large number of streamers and balloons had been purchased by a government employee shortly before the bombs fell. We have traced the employee to a nearby government building. We are going to send a team to the facility to find and retrieve the missing party supplies.
ZH: 虽然在大无敌超市没找到任何派对用品，但我们的队伍发现，有位政府人员在炸弹落下前不久大量购买了彩带和气球。我们追踪到这位官员的下落，发现他在附近的一座政府大楼里。我们得派人去那儿找回那些派对用品。

EN: While looking for decorations, our team discovered something at the old government building that was a surprise to us all. We have since sifted through the data in all of our logs and found reference to a government facility that may hold more revelatory information. This may lead us to some tech that could help us improve the Vault leaps and bounds beyond what was planned. We need to send out a team as soon as possible!
ZH: 在寻找装饰品的过程中，我们在那座旧政府大楼里发现了让我们大吃一惊的东西。我们查阅了所有日志，发现其中提到了一处可能藏有更多秘密信息的政府设施。我们有可能可以找到一些科技帮助我们大幅提升避难所的实力。我们需要尽快派队伍出发！

EN: We stumbled on something unbelievable at the government facility. When we took a further look into the research data, we found records of a field research lab at a so-called "crash site" where they were conducting experiments on "the object." Let's get to this crash site and see what we can scavenge!
ZH: 我们在政府设施里碰到了一些难以置信的东西。当我们深入研究那些数据时，发现有记录提到一处“坠毁现场”，那里有个实地研究实验室，曾进行着关于“某个物体”的实验。快去这处坠毁现场，看看我们能捡到什么好东西！

EN: We've been churning through the data that came back from that UFO lab we scouted a while back. Turns out, the old government turned over most of their specimens to RobCo. We found a holotape among the junk you brought back from the UFO Crash Site mentioning something about the next step in the development of advanced AI. Luckily, the nearest RobCo factory is pretty close to our vault. Let's send some dwellers there and see if we can find that research data. It could make a big difference for our vault!
ZH: 我们一直在分析从外星飞船实验室带回来的数据。结果发现，旧政府把大部分样本都交给了罗伯科公司。我们从你带回来的飞船坠毁现场垃圾里找到了一张磁带，上面提到下个阶段的先进人工智能开发。幸运的是，我们避难所附近就有一个罗伯科公司的工厂。快派些居民去那里，看看能不能找到那份研究数据，这对我们的避难所将大有帮助！

EN: We cracked the executive's logs from the RobCo factory and discovered the location of a secret RobCo R&D facility. It occupies a series of secret levels below a retail store at the local mall. RobCo was using alien technology to advance their robotics research. They were trying to build something big. If we can figure out what they knew, we should be able to use it to make major improvements to the Vault!
ZH: 我们破解了罗伯科公司工厂高管的日志，发现了一处秘密的研发设施。它就藏在当地商场的一家零售店地下，罗伯科公司竟然在利用外星科技推进他们的机器人研究。他们试图打造一些大玩意儿。如果我们能搞清楚他们知道些什么，就能对避难所进行大幅改进！

EN: Find party decorations in the Super Duper Mart.
ZH: 在大无敌超市里找到派对装饰品。

EN: Search for the missing party supplies in the government building.
ZH: 在政府大楼内寻找派对用品。

EN: Investigate the government research facility.
ZH: 调查政府研究设施。

EN: Go to the crash site field lab and find the alien tech.
ZH: 前往坠毁现场的实验室，找到外星科技。

EN: Search the RobCo factory for extraterrestrial technology.
ZH: 搜索罗伯科公司工厂，寻找外星科技。

EN: Get into the secret RobCo R&D facility and track down their research data.
ZH: 进入罗伯科公司秘密研发基地，获取研究数据。

EN: Unauthorized personnel. Intruder alert. Activate Security Protocols!
ZH: 人员未授权，入侵者警告。激活安全协议！

EN: Scanning... Robco personnel positively identified. Welcome to site X 71 A. Please enjoy your stay.
ZH: 扫描中……确认罗伯科公司人员身份。欢迎来到X71A，祝您今日愉快。

EN: Assessing... yes that is reasonable. Collect your items and be gone.
ZH: 评估中……好吧，还算合理。拿好你的东西，赶紧离开。

EN: Ugh whatever. Prepare to meet your maker, you walking toaster!
ZH: 呃，随便啦，准备爆炸吧，你这个会走路的烤面包机！

EN: We went through a lot to get here. We are not leaving empty handed.
ZH: 我们费了不少功夫才来到这里，可不想空手而归。

EN: Did you say Vault-Tec? But uh, we're from Robco... yeah! RobCo! Here's my ID!
ZH: 你说避难所科技？但是呃，我们是罗伯科公司的人……对！罗伯科公司！这是我的身份证明！

EN: Ok ok, we're going. Just let us... uh... grab this computer we definitely brought and we'll go!
ZH: 好吧好吧，我们走。只要让我们……呃……拿上我们带来的电脑，我们就走！

EN: Party Favors
ZH: 派对福利

EN: Mandatory Fun
ZH: 必需的乐趣

EN: The Truth Is In Here
ZH: 真相就在这里

EN: Enclosed Encounters
ZH: 在室内的邂逅

EN: Factory Upgrade
ZH: 工厂升级

EN: My Friends Are Electric
ZH: 我的电动朋友

EN: Retrieve party decorations.
ZH: 获取派对装饰品。

EN: Find missing party decorations.
ZH: 寻找丢失的派对装饰品。

EN: Find evidence of alien experimentation
ZH: 找到外星实验的证据。

EN: Find Alien Tech
ZH: 找到外星科技。

EN: Discover where RobCo is keeping their research
ZH: 找到罗伯科公司的秘密研究地点。

EN: Enter and explore the UFO lab.
ZH: 进入并探索UFO实验室。

EN: Searching In The Dark
ZH: 在黑暗中搜索

EN: There is now that *you* showed up!
ZH: 现在*你*出现了！

EN: Okay, first, that's rude. Second, there hasn't been any food here in months.
ZH: 首先，这很不礼貌，其次，这儿已经好几个月没吃的了。

EN: I'm so sorry, there's no food left here. This is all we got.
ZH: 不好意思，这儿没有剩的食物。这是我们全部家当了。

EN: Welcome to Super-Duper Mart!
ZH: 欢迎来到大无敌超市！

EN: How can we be of service today?
ZH: 我们今天能为您做些什么？

EN: So, is there any food left here at all?
ZH: 那么，这里还有食物吗？

EN: Just give us your food.
ZH: 把你的食物给我们。

EN: Sorry to trouble you. We're looking for these ingredients.
ZH: 对不起，麻烦你了。我们正在寻找这些原料。

EN: Our new chef has some bold ideas to spruce up our daily fare, and he's made a list of specific ingredients he needs. We should visit a nearby abandoned Super-Duper Mart to see if we can find any of them.
ZH: 我们的新厨师有一些大胆的想法来改善我们的日常饮食，他列出了所需要的具体食材。我们应该去附近一个废弃的大无敌超市看看能不能找到。

EN: All Sales Final
ZH: 一经售出概不退换

EN: Search the Super-Duper Mart for ingredients.
ZH: 在大无敌超市里寻找食材。

EN: Retrieve ingredients from infested Super-Duper Mart.
ZH: 从被感染的大无敌超市中获取原料。

EN: I don't think there's any food left in here...
ZH: 我觉得这儿没有食物剩下……

EN: This was a bad idea.
ZH: 这是个坏主意。

EN: Oh my goodness! What a disaster!
ZH: 哦我的天！真是场灾难！

EN: Rubarb's Raiders came here and started wreaking havoc!
ZH: 鲁巴布的掠夺者来这里，想搞大破坏！

EN: But one of them was wearing this terrible cologne...
ZH: 但他们中有个人喷了古龙香水，很糟糕的味道……

EN: And it attracted a Deathclaw!
ZH: 关键是这味道吸引了一只死爪！

EN: Cool.
ZH: 赞。

EN: Don't say we didn't give you a chance!
ZH: 可别说我们没给你机会！

EN: Just that way. But be careful! Because, you know... Deathclaw.
ZH: 那条路吧。但是小心点！因为，你知道的……有死爪。

EN: Tell you what. Take this. It might protect you. But probably not.
ZH: 跟你们说，来，拿着这个。这个可能能保护你。但也可能没用。

EN: Whoa whoa whoa! Don't shoot!
ZH: 等等，等等！别开枪！

EN: We don't want no trouble!
ZH: 我们可不想惹麻烦！

EN: Rubarb sent us here, but then the Deathclaw came, and...
ZH: 鲁巴布派我们来的，但后来死爪又来了，然后……

EN: Look. We just want to get out alive. Cool?
ZH: 听着，我们只想活着出去，放我们走行吗？

EN: Cool.
ZH: 赞。

EN: No. So totally NOT cool.
ZH: 不行。完全不想放你们走。

EN: Fine. But where is Overseer Chang?
ZH: 好吧。但告诉我们监督者阿昌在哪儿？

EN: Ya bunch o' cowards! Can you at least lend a hand?
ZH: 你们这群懦夫！至少过来帮帮忙吧？

EN: First Raiders then a Deathclaw. I think it might be time to resign.
ZH: 先是掠夺者，然后是死爪。我想是时候辞职了。

EN: Rubarb has found another Vault to liberate. Time to head out and rescue Overseer Chang from the Raiders!
ZH: 鲁巴布又发现了一个要解放的避难所。是时候出发然后从掠夺者手中救出监督者阿昌了。

EN: All Work and No Play
ZH: 只工作不娱乐

EN: Rescue Overseer Chang.
ZH: 拯救监督者阿昌。

EN: Rescue Overseer Chang from Rubarb's Raiders.
ZH: 从鲁巴布的掠夺者手中拯救监督者阿昌。

EN: No, but being on a diet doesn't mean I can't check the menu!
ZH: 不，但是节食不意味着我就不能看菜单了呀！

EN: Great idea! You should go and tell them. Take this for courage.
ZH: 好主意！你应该去告诉他们。来拿着这个以示勇气。

EN: I think there's one left, hiding in one of the Vault rooms.
ZH: 我想还剩一个，藏在某个避难所房间里。

EN: So, you're here for the Singles Night, huh?
ZH: 所以，你来这里参加单身之夜的，是吗？

EN: Don't get your hopes up. There aren't that many left.
ZH: 不要抱太大希望，已经没剩多少了。

EN: Plus, there's a group of Dwellers intimidating would-be suitors.
ZH: 再加上，有一群居民正在恐吓那些想来相亲的追求者。

EN: I'm not sure they're really Dwellers, either.
ZH: 我也不确定他们是不是真的是居民。

EN: Are you Single?
ZH: 你是单身吗？

EN: Maybe those disruptive Dwellers should be asked to leave.
ZH: 可能那些讨厌的居民应该被请出去。

EN: Are there any Singles here at all?
ZH: 这里到底有没有单身汉啊？

EN: No one mocks my mojo!
ZH: 没有人敢嘲笑我的符咒！

EN: I can. I did. And now I'm calling dibs on killing you.
ZH: 我可以。我也这么做了。现在我已经抢先预订要杀了你。

EN: There are? All right boys, let's blow this joint. Here, take this to remember how I let you live.
ZH: 真有？好吧兄弟们，咱们离开这个鬼地方吧。来，拿着这个，记住是我饶了你一命。

EN: Well, shooting *you* in the face would certainly lift my spirits!
ZH: 这个，杀了你当然能振奋我的精神！

EN: Sorry mate, you've come all the way here for nothing.
ZH: 不好意思了兄弟，让你这么远白跑一趟。

EN: There's only one single person left, and I already called dibs.
ZH: 现在只有一个单身人士剩下了，而我早就已经预订了。

EN: So, yeah, get out of here so I can get my groove on.
ZH: 所以，没错，滚出去吧，好让我好好享受。

EN: You couldn't get that groove on if your life depended on it.
ZH: 就算拿命来赌，你也嗨不起来。

EN: You can't call dibs on someone.
ZH: 你不能预订一个人。

EN: Pfft, there are many more singles over at Vault 332. Like, tons.
ZH: 切，在332号避难所有那么多单身汉，成吨呢。

EN: Have you tried shooting yourself in the face first? Might improve your chances.
ZH: 你有试过先朝自己的脸上开一枪吗？可能可以增大你的概率哦。

EN: I was waiting for you all that time, and now you're here.
ZH: 我一直都在等你，现在你来了。

EN: That's fine, but do put on a hat before you go out. It's cold outside.
ZH: 好吧，但是出去前一定戴上帽子。外面挺冷的。

EN: *More* suitors? This is getting ridiculous.
ZH: 更多的追求者？这真是越来越离谱了。

EN: Although, I have to say... You're rather sweet on the eyes.
ZH: 即使这样，我必须得说……你还挺好看的。

EN: Hmm... Is it me, or is it getting hot in here?
ZH: 嗯……是我有问题，还是这里越来越热了？

EN: I probed the Wasteland searching for you, and here you are.
ZH: 我探索了废土，试图找到你，结果你在这里。

EN: I'm sorry, this can't work. You look too much like my mother.
ZH: 抱歉，我觉得这个行不通，你长得太像我妈了。

EN: We've received word that a nearby Vault is holding a Singles Night for Valentine's Day, and they've invited us to participate!
ZH: 我们收到消息，附近的一个避难所正在为情人节举行单身之夜的活动，他们邀请了我们同去！

EN: All's Fair in Love and Nuclear War
ZH: 爱与核战，皆不择手段

EN: Meet that special someone.
ZH: 快来遇见那个特殊的人。

EN: Dissuade rival suitors.
ZH: 快来阻止其他的情敌。

EN: Travel to a nearby Vault to find a potential mate.
ZH: 去附近的避难所找到潜在的伴侣。

EN: Phew! I was afraid I'd have to dance.
ZH: 咻！我还担心一定要我跳舞呢。

EN: This is going about as well as I expected.
ZH: 事情进展得和我预料的一样顺利。

EN: Almost Human
ZH: 半人半鬼

EN: You're not going to leave adorable animals trapped in that building, are you?
ZH: 你是不会让那些可爱的小动物们困在那幢建筑里的，对吧？

EN: Animal Rescue
ZH: 拯救小动物

EN: Recover the Pet Carrier.
ZH: 找回宠物笼子。

EN: Find any lost animals.
ZH: 找到任何走失的动物。

EN: You came across an old cabin while adventuring in the Wasteland. Perhaps you should see what's inside.
ZH: 当你在废土探险的时候发现了一个小屋。也许你该看看里面有什么。

EN: Anybody Home?
ZH: 有人在家吗？

EN: Explore the Cabin.
ZH: 探索小屋。

EN: You found a Cabin in the Wasteland.
ZH: 在废土上发现一间小屋。

EN: You working for those water-drenched wingnuts at the Vault-Tec offices?
ZH: 你是为那些避难所科技工作室里被水淋透的傻子们工作的吗？

EN: If you're as weak-minded as they are, this should be easy peasy!
ZH: 如果你像他们那样意志薄弱，这应该很容易！

EN: The only way we can get more information about the Water Wizard is to clear out this Raider camp. Should be a walk in the park!
ZH: 我们能获得更多关于水之术士的信息的唯一方法就是清除这个掠夺者营地。应该像在公园里散步一样容易！

EN: Aqua Nuka-Cola
ZH: 水核子可乐

EN: Clear out the Raider camp.
ZH: 清除掠夺者营地。

EN: Clear out the Raider camp for the settlers in the Vault-Tec offices.
ZH: 为那些避难所科技工作室的定居者们清空掠夺者营地。

EN: His former assistant is holed up in a Super-Duper Mart off yonder.  He'll know for sure.
ZH: 他的前助手是躲藏在一个大无敌超市那边。他肯定会知道。

EN: You took down Cruddy Bonez and his gang, huh? Guess they won't be calling us “wingnuts” anymore...
ZH: 你拿下了科鲁迪博纳兹和他的团伙？我猜他们再也不敢叫我们“傻子”了……

EN: We met the Wizard a while ago. Good salesman, and the water tasted amazing.
ZH: 我们刚刚碰到了术士。他是个好的销售员，他的水味道棒极了。

EN: We got enough to tell any effects were in the mind of the user and totally coincidental.
ZH: 喝的足够多了，我们知道任何影响都只存在于用户的头脑中，纯属巧合。

EN: This *is* some delicious water, but he's ripping people off, and he needs to be stopped.
ZH: 这水确实不错，但他这是欺诈，得阻止他。

EN: Do you know where we can find him?
ZH: 你知道我们在哪儿能找到他吗？

EN: We did what the people at the Vault-Tec offices asked. Now it's time for some answers!
ZH: 我们做了那些避难所科技办公室的人拜托的事情。现在是回答的时候了！

EN: Aqua-schema
ZH: 水的阴谋

EN: Return to the Vault-Tec offices.
ZH: 返回避难所科技办公室。

EN: Return to the Vault-Tec offices.
ZH: 返回避难所科技办公室。

EN: Dead men tell no tales.
ZH: 人死了就无从对证了。

EN: Let's feed 'em to the fishes!
ZH: 让我们把他们丢去喂鱼吧！

EN: Grandpa wants to play Pirates, but he needs a Parrot first.
ZH: 爷爷想要扮海盗，但是首先得有一只鹦鹉。

EN: Argh, Matey!
ZH: 嚯，海盗！

EN: Find the Parrot.
ZH: 找到那只鹦鹉。

EN: Find a Parrot.
ZH: 找鹦鹉。

EN: Shiver me timbers, it's a land lubber.
ZH: 吓我一跳，原来是个旱鸭子。

EN: We'll make you walk the plank.
ZH: 我们会让你吃不了兜着走。

EN: Hang 'em from the yardarm!
ZH: 把他们挂在桅杆上示众！

EN: Sure thing!
ZH: 当然！

EN: Of course.
ZH: 当然。

EN: That was close! I guess you heard my message, huh?
ZH: 差一点！我猜你们听到我说的了吧？
